connect.refuseMobileData: This vault's address isn't secure, so the app only uses it on Wi-Fi.
connect.httpsOnly: This app only connects to a vault over a secure address, starting https://. Ask whoever looks after your vault for its https address.
connect.certificateNotAccepted: This app can't open your vault safely yet. Ask whoever looks after your vault to help.
connect.certificateNotAcceptedHost: For whoever looks after the vault: this app only accepts a certificate the phone already trusts, such as one from Let's Encrypt or Tailscale. A certificate the vault made itself, installed on the phone, isn't used.
connect.stranger: Something else is answering at {{host}} — not the vault you signed in to. Nothing was sent. If the vault was reinstalled, sign in again.
connect.reinstalled: This vault has been reinstalled since you last signed in. Sign in again.
connect.certificateUntrusted: This phone doesn't trust your vault's certificate yet. If your vault makes its own certificate, install it on this phone once — here's how.
connect.certificateWrongName: Your vault's certificate is for a different name. Use the address the certificate was made for — the one your browser shows when you open the vault.
connect.certificateExpired: Your vault's certificate has run out — or this phone's date is wrong. Check the date in the phone's settings; if it is right, whoever looks after the vault can renew the certificate.
connect.guideAndroid1: 1. Get the certificate file from whoever looks after your vault. For a vault that makes its own, it is vault-ca.crt (the vault's README says how to copy it out).
connect.guideAndroid2: 2. Put the file on this phone, then open Settings and search for "CA certificate" (it is under Security, then Encryption & credentials, then Install a certificate).
connect.guideAndroid3: 3. Android warns that a certificate you install can vouch for websites. Choose Install anyway, then pick vault-ca.crt.
connect.guideAndroid4: 4. Come back here and connect again.
connect.guideAndroidRemove: It stays until you remove it, under Encryption & credentials, then User credentials.
connect.guideIphone: Open vault-ca.crt on this iPhone and install the profile it offers (Settings, General, VPN & Device Management). Then turn on full trust for it in Settings, General, About, Certificate Trust Settings. Come back here and connect again.
connect.captivePortal: Something answered, but it looks like a Wi-Fi sign-in page. Finish signing in to the Wi-Fi, then try again.
connect.linkJoin: Invitations are accepted in the browser. Open it there, then come back and sign in.

emergencyEdit.dateOfBirth: Date of birth: {{date}}. It comes from the family’s details, and is changed there.
emergencyEdit.removeWords: It comes off when you save. Until then, Cancel at the foot keeps everything as it was.
emergencyEdit.clearWords: Everything in it comes off when you save. Until then, Cancel at the foot keeps everything as it was.
emergencyEdit.insuranceCard: The card itself is a document: file it as an Insurance card.
emergencyEdit.notesHint: Anything else someone helping should know, in your own words.
emergencyEdit.nameNeeded: Give it a name, or leave the entry out.
emergencyEdit.putRight: Something above needs putting right first.
emergencyEdit.changed: Someone else changed this while you were editing. What you typed is still here: Save again puts it in place of their version, or Cancel and open it again to see theirs first.

emergencyWho.titleMine: Who can see your emergency information
emergencyWho.title: Who can see {{name}}’s emergency information
emergencyWho.alwaysMine: You and the owners always can, and so can a caregiver you keep.
emergencyWho.always: {{name}} and the owners always can, and so can a caregiver they keep.
emergencyWho.dropped_one: {{names}} can no longer be chosen and was taken off.
emergencyWho.dropped_other: {{names}} can no longer be chosen and were taken off.
emergencyWho.exports: Anyone who can no longer see it loses any export they made of it.
emergencyWho.saved: Who can see it is saved.

walletCard.title: Print a wallet card
walletCard.words: Tick what goes on it. It needs nothing but the paper: no link, and no code to scan.
walletCard.nothingTicked: Tick at least one part to put on the card.
walletCard.letters: Some letters can’t go on the printed card, and print as “?”: {{letters}}
walletCard.leaves: Share or print makes a PDF on this phone, the size of a bank card on an A4 page: print it at actual size. Once it goes to another app, the vault can’t protect it.
walletCard.failed: The card couldn’t be made. Try again.

changeLink.title: Change the link
changeLink.words: It stays the same link, to the same document. Change what you like; anything that lets it do more asks you to confirm it’s you.
changeLink.wordsCollection: It stays the same link, to the same documents. Change what you like; anything that lets it do more asks you to confirm it’s you.
changeLink.latest: It can last until {{end}} at the latest: as long as a link may from when it was made.
changeLink.emergencyView: They see the parts of the page you ticked. It is to view, always.
changeLink.noneAsNow: No PIN or password, as now
changeLink.passwordShort: At least 8 characters. Something they can type, and you can say to them.
changeLink.typedNote: At least 8 characters. The vault keeps only a scrambled copy, so write it down before you tell them.
changeLink.madeNote: Three short groups of letters and numbers, easy to read out. You see it once you save.
changeLink.oldStops_pin: The old PIN stops working at once. Anyone with a page open has to open the link again.
changeLink.oldStops_password: The old password stops working at once. Anyone with a page open has to open the link again.
changeLink.notMaker_pin: It asks for a PIN. Only whoever made it can change its PIN or password: to change that, end this link and make a new one.
changeLink.notMaker_password: It asks for a password. Only whoever made it can change its PIN or password: to change that, end this link and make a new one.
changeLink.notMakerNone: It asks for no PIN or password. Only whoever made it can change that: end this link and make a new one.
changeLink.codeByEmail: It emails a code to {{to}} when it is opened. To send the code somewhere else, end this link and make a new one.
changeLink.codeByText: It texts a code to {{to}} when it is opened. To send the code somewhere else, end this link and make a new one.
changeLink.oneBrowser: It opens only in the first browser that opened it. To let it open somewhere else, end this link and make a new one.
changeLink.asksMore: Anything that lets it do more asks you to confirm it’s you.
changeLink.newWords_pin: The link is changed. The old PIN, if it had one, no longer works.
changeLink.newWords_password: The link is changed. The old password, if it had one, no longer works.
changeLink.tellApart_pin: Tell them the new PIN some other way — a phone call, not the same message as the link.
changeLink.tellApart_password: Tell them the new password some other way — a phone call, not the same message as the link.
changeLink.seeAgain: You can see it again with Show the link.
changeLink.onlyNow: It is shown only now, so write it down.
changeLink.wordsEmergency: It stays the same link, to the same page. Change what you like; anything that lets it do more asks you to confirm it’s you.

docLinks.title: Its links outside the family
docLinks.words: The links to it that work now, newest first. Change one, or end it; More → Sharing has every link.

requests.title: Asking for documents
requests.words: A link for someone outside the family to send you files — your accountant, a solicitor. They see nothing in the vault.
requests.anyAdult: Any adult looks at what comes in
requests.pausedLocked: Paused while the sign-in of {{who}} is locked. It works again once they are unlocked.
requests.pausedSignIn: Paused until the sign-in of {{who}} is turned back on after the restore.
requests.pausedRestoreOnlyYou: Paused after a restore. Only you can see it, so nobody can turn it back on: end it and ask again.
requests.pausedRestoreOwner: Paused after a restore, until an owner turns it back on.
requests.usedUp: Opened as many times as it allows
requests.locked: Stopped: a wrong password or code was typed ten times
requests.closedLostRight: Closed: whoever asked can no longer ask for documents
requests.endWords: {{who}} can no longer open it or send anything, even on a page they have open now. What they have sent already stays, for you to look at. You can make a new request whenever you like.
requests.ended: The request “{{title}}” is ended. What was sent already stays.
requests.onButLocked: The request “{{title}}” is turned back on. It stays paused until {{who}} is unlocked, from their page.
requests.onButSignIn: The request “{{title}}” is turned back on. It works once {{who}} can sign in again: turn their sign-in back on too.
requests.onButPaused: The request “{{title}}” is turned back on, but it is still paused for now.
requests.passwordApart: Tell them the password some other way — a phone call, not the same message.
requests.onlyYou: Only you can see this again, and only after confirming it’s you. Closing hides it.

ask.title: Ask for documents
ask.lede: Send someone outside the family a link to put files in — your accountant, a solicitor. They see nothing in the vault, and what they send waits apart from your documents until it is looked at.
ask.notAllowed: Only an owner or an adult can ask someone to send documents.
ask.needsConnection: Asking for documents needs a connection to the vault.
ask.titleNote: They see it once they open the link.
ask.titleProblem: Say what you are asking for.
ask.messageHint: If you like: what you need, and by when.
ask.itemsNote: Each gets its own place on their page: W-2, 1099. Up to {{max}}. They can always send anything else as well.
ask.label: Who is it for?
ask.labelHint: For your own list, and the activity log. They do not see it.
ask.personHint: Only for whoever looks at what comes in. The person sending never sees it.
ask.endNote: A request lasts {{days}} days at most. There is no request without an end.
ask.latest: It can last until {{end}} at the latest: as long as a request may from when it was made.
ask.withPin: Ask for a four-digit PIN, which you tell them separately
ask.pinNote: The vault makes the PIN up. You see it once, with the link. A PIN or a password, never both.
ask.withPassword: Also ask for a password, which you tell them separately
ask.passwordTypedNote: At least {{min}} characters, checked exactly as typed. The vault keeps only a scrambled copy, so write it down before you send the link.
ask.passwordMadeNote: Three short groups of letters and numbers, easy to read out. You see it once, with the link. Capitals, spaces and dashes do not matter when they type it.
ask.passwordProblem: At least {{min}} characters. Something they can type, and you can say to them.
ask.withCode: Also email them a code when they open it
ask.emailNote: The code goes only to this address, from the vault’s own mail server. They never type an address; they see it with most of it hidden.
ask.emailProblem: Their email address, which the code will go to: name@example.com.
ask.deviceOnlyNote: The first browser that opens it is the only one it will open in. If they open it on their phone, it will not open on their computer.
ask.limitVisitsNote: Each press of Open is a visit. Reloading the page it opens is not.
ask.maxMbNote: Up to {{max}} MB, all files together.
ask.sizeProblem: A number of MB from 1 to {{max}}.
ask.acceptNote_standard: What a file is is decided from its contents, never its name.
ask.acceptNote_office: Word and Excel files with macros, or that load anything from elsewhere, are refused. What a file is is decided from its contents, never its name.
ask.closeAfter: Close it once they press Finish
ask.closeAfterNote: Then the link takes nothing more. Leave it open if they may send things in more than one go.
ask.reviewH: Who looks at what comes in
ask.reviewNote_me: Only you can see what they send, until you file it. No other owner or adult can.
ask.reviewNote_adults: Any owner or adult can see what they send, and file it. Teens and viewers never see it.
ask.probably: You will be told it is probably {{name}}’s.
ask.putRight: Something above needs putting right first.
ask.insecure: This link starts with http://, not https://, so whoever you send it to will not be able to send anything: their browser will not open it over a connection that is not secure. Ask whoever looks after the vault to give it an https:// address first.
ask.pinApart: Tell them the PIN some other way — a phone call, not the same message.
ask.termsPin: They will be asked for the PIN.
ask.passwordApart: Tell them this some other way — a phone call, not the same message. Capitals, spaces and dashes do not matter when they type it.
ask.againLater: You can see this link, and its password, again in More → Sharing, after confirming it’s you.
ask.againLaterPin: You can see this link, and its PIN, again in More → Sharing, after confirming it’s you.
ask.onlyNow: The link is shown only now: the vault keeps a scrambled copy it cannot show again. Send it or copy it before you close this.
ask.termsSends: They can send {{files}}, {{mb}} MB in all: {{types}}.
ask.termsChosenPassword: They will be asked for the password you chose.
ask.termsCode: When they open it, a code is emailed to {{to}}, and they type it in. It works once, for 10 minutes.
ask.termsDevice: It opens only in the first browser that opens it.
ask.termsCloses: It closes once they press Finish.
ask.termsReview_me: Only you will see what they send, until you file it.
ask.termsReview_adults: Any owner or adult can see what they send, and file it.
ask.anyone: Anyone with the link can send files until it ends, and see nothing in the vault. You will see when it is opened, and you can end it from More → Sharing whenever you like.
ask.changeLede: It stays the same link. Change what you like; anything that lets it do more asks you to confirm it’s you.
ask.cannotChange: That request can’t be changed: it has ended, or somebody else asked for it. Make a new one if you need to.
ask.fixedReview_mine: Only you look at what comes in.
ask.fixedReview_theirs: Only whoever asked looks at what comes in.
ask.fixedReview_adults: Any adult looks at what comes in.
ask.fixedNote: The things to send, and who looks at what comes in, stay as they are. To change those, end this request and make a new one.
ask.noSecretAsNow: No PIN or password, as now
ask.oldStops: The old password stops working at once. Anyone with a page open has to open the link again.
ask.oldStopsPin: The old PIN stops working at once. Anyone with a page open has to open the link again.
ask.notMakerPin: It asks for a PIN. Only whoever asked can change its PIN or password: to change that, end this request and make a new one.
ask.newPinWords: The request is changed. The old PIN, if it had one, no longer works.
ask.notMaker: It asks for a password. Only whoever asked can change its password: to change that, end this request and make a new one.
ask.notMakerNone: It asks for no password. Only whoever asked can change that: end this request and make a new one.
ask.codeFixed: It emails a code to {{to}} when it is opened. To send the code somewhere else, end this request and make a new one.
ask.deviceFixed: It opens only in the first browser that opened it. To let it open somewhere else, end this request and make a new one.
ask.newPasswordWords: The request is changed. The old password, if it had one, no longer works.
ask.requestEnded: That request no longer works, so it can’t be changed. Make a new one if you need to.
ask.codeUnavailableWords: This vault cannot email codes: whoever runs it has not given it a mail server.
ask.cannotChangeOwner: That request has ended, so it can’t be changed. Make a new one if you need to.
ask.changedMeanwhile: This request was changed somewhere else while it was open here, so the form starts again from it as it is now.

download.chooseWords: Tick the documents to download. One comes as itself; several come as one ZIP, with an index saying what each is.
download.done_one: The document is ready: saved where you chose.
download.done_other: The {{count}} documents are ready, as one ZIP: saved where you chose.
download.noFile: This document has no file to download.
download.nothingChosen: None of these has a file you can download: a note you can’t open, or a document kept without its file, isn’t included.
download.collectionHint: Everything in it you may download, as one ZIP
download.collectionDone: Everything you may download from “{{name}}” is ready, as one ZIP: saved where you chose.
download.nothingInCollection: Nothing in this collection has a file you can download: a note you can’t open, or a document kept without its file, isn’t included.
download.needsConnection: Downloading needs a connection to the vault.
download.failed: The download couldn’t be made. Try again.
download.tooLarge: That is more than one download holds: {{documents}} documents or {{gb}} GB. Choose fewer, or download everything from Export on the web.
download.ticketGone: The download ran out before it could start. Try Download again.
download.tooLargePlain: That is more than one download holds. Choose fewer, or download everything from Export on the web.

endedSharing.title: Links and requests that no longer work
endedSharing.words: A link or a request no longer works once it is ended, closed, stopped after wrong codes, or past its end. One that is only paused or used up is not removed until its end has passed too.
endedSharing.soonerWords: Links and requests that ended more than {{span}} ago will be removed from Sharing the next night, and can’t be brought back.

activity.title: Activity
activity.words: Everything anybody has done in this vault. Your own private documents are only ever in your copy of this list.
activity.needsConnection: Activity needs a connection to the vault.
activity.daysWords: Days on the household’s calendar, as the times are said.
activity.documentChipOff: Take off the filter {{what}}, and show everything
activity.nothingInStretch: Nothing in this stretch. Show older to look further back.
activity.nothingLoadedMatches: Nothing loaded matches these filters. Show older to look further back.

opens.showFor_one: Who opened the link for {{who}}, when: once
opens.showFor_other: Who opened the link for {{who}}, when: {{count}} times
opens.hideFor: Hide who opened the link for {{who}}
opens.theirWords: This is sensitive and it’s yours, so you can see every link to it and who opened each.

print.pagesHint: As the vault shows them: the first {{max}} at most.
print.detailsHint: What it is, whose it is, its dates and its status, and its note.
print.noPagesDrawn: The vault shows no pages of this file, so only its details can be printed.
print.notConfirmed: Nothing was printed: it wasn't confirmed to be you.
print.pagesFailed: Its pages couldn't be read for printing. Try again.
print.notOnPhone: Its pages aren't on this phone. Connect to your vault to print them.
print.pagesCut: Pages 1–{{last}} of {{of}}. The rest weren't printed.
print.pagesMissing_one: Page {{pages}} couldn't be read, so it isn't printed.
print.pagesMissing_other: Pages {{pages}} couldn't be read, so they aren't printed.
print.pagesPending: The vault is still preparing its pages. Try again in a minute.
print.noPages: The vault shows no pages of this file. Choose its details to print those.
print.detailsOnly: The vault shows no pages of this file, so only its details were printed.
print.failed: It couldn't be printed. Try again.
print.collectionLede: Everything in it you can see, as a table: its name, kind, whose it is, its dates, status and where it is kept.
print.tick: A box to tick beside each
print.tickHint: For checking them off by hand.
print.activityEverything: Everything the activity log shows you.
print.activityBackTo: Goes back to {{day}}. There is older activity: show older first to print it too.
